items.title: Crypto investigators flag suspected $106M theft, $786K Solana bot drain
items.summary: A European entity may have lost $106 million from exchange accounts, while a wallet associated with a Solana arbitrage bot may have lost another $786,000.

items.title: Mystery $106 Million Crypto Theft Hits EU Entity Days After Binance Hack
